title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (pure-insertion diff failure on .moeb/README.md)
description: patch_file was called 3 times with pure insertion diffs (no removed lines) on Cargo.toml, mod.rs, and tool_executor_tests.rs. All three calls failed. The agent fell back to write_file with full content, which worked correctly.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file fails to apply pure insertion unified diffs. The agent wrote complete file replacements as fallback.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash for two operations with no moeb equivalent: (1) rm -f to delete incorrectly-placed github_releases.rs, (2) cargo build --release and cargo test for Step 6 verification.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a delete_file moeb tool and a run_command/cargo_check tool.

title: run.skill.md should direct agents to use write_file for pure-insertion changes
description: 3 patch_file failures incurred on pure insertion diffs before falling back to write_file. Skill should instruct agents to use write_file directly when all changes are insertions.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to Phase 3 of run.skill.md: if the change is a pure insertion (no lines removed), use write_file instead of patch_file.
